events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger at 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune from the main man?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single released (1975)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem "Imagine" was first released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon's timeless message of peace, 'Imagine', first hit the airwaves as a UK single. Its message resonates as strongly today as ever.

events.title: Apple launched the first iPod (2001)
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped a game-changer that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you fill yours with?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of the iconic 007 film franchise on James Bond Day.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating the world's most famous secret agent. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: A true visionary and musical genius. John Lennon would have turned 86 today. His songs continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The celebrated British comedian, actor, and Monty Python star John Cleese marks his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: From silly walks to 'Fawlty Towers', the incomparable John Cleese is 87 today! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, diverse masterpiece, 'The White Album'. Which track is your unexpected favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury (35 years)
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true icon. Remembering the extraordinary talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury. His music lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring hits like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, showcasing new sounds and lyrical depth. Which track defines it for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon (46 years)
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Passing
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, the world still remembers John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music continues to resonate globally.
